stem:
Purple loosestrife is an invasive flowering plant species now found in North America. In an effort to control the purple loosestrife, biologists tested and released three beetle species to use as a biological control of the plant.

| Beetle Species | Effect on Purple Loosestrife |
| --- | --- |
| *Galerucella pusilla* | Feeds on leaves and new shoots |
| *Hylobius transversovittatus* | Deposits eggs in the stem; larvae feed on root tissue |
| *Nanophyes marmoratus* | Feeds on flowers and reduces seed production |

Which result is an unintended negative consequence of releasing these beetle species into the environment?

options.label: A
options.text: There will be an increase in the available habitat for non-native plant species.

options.label: B
options.text: There will be an increase in the population numbers of native beetle species in the habitat.

options.label: C
options.text: There will be an increase in competition for food resources among all beetle species in the habitat.

options.label: D
options.text: There will be an increase in pollination of native flowering plant species.
